annotations.title: Lay a stills post out for another network

description: Make a new draft post from a stills post, laid out again for another network's size (Instagram feed 1080x1350, Stories and TikTok 1080x1920, Pinterest 1000x1500). The photos, their focus points, words and stickers are the same; the layout is filled again at the new size, and words and stickers move into the network's safe zone. The picture is drawn again from the photos, not stretched. For Pinterest each slide becomes its own pin (at most 10): one call makes one pin, pin says which (0 is the first), and the answer's next_pin is the one to ask for next (null when done). The original is not changed. stills_get says when the new post is ready.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

pin.description: Pinterest only: which slide's pin to make (0 is the first)

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
